\subsection{Conclusions}
Current-STA transactional repair exposes useful, conditional timing--resource tradeoffs on fixed 3D routing graphs. The matched BNN flows exchange 1786 wire for 39 SB and two CB at equal CPD, with 24.91\% mean complete-time overhead in symmetric repeats; setup regressions make the endpoint cost explicit. Fixed-scope controls attribute R1 improvements to coordination and distinguish robot domain restrictions from failure release. No-cut, no-gain, routing-failure and timeout inputs define the measured applicability boundary. These results support selecting mechanisms and terminal policies according to resource scarcity and timing requirements; they do not establish broad controller superiority, timing-closure guarantees or statistical acceleration.
